name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-float-as-byte-union-negative-1-p.bal
reason: The case asserts a panic when a union-typed value holding float -1.0 is cast to byte. Type definitions, function calls, local declarations, numeric literals/unary minus and type casts are supported, with no restriction excluding this union cast or its failing runtime behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment identifies the expected failing cast; the record alternative is declared but never constructed.
